events.title: England make it four wins from their first five World Cup qualifying matches after defeating Turkey 2–0 away in İzmir . The month ends with 노리치 시티 back on top of the Premier League, though 애스턴 빌라 are just a point behind with a match in hand. 맨체스터 유나이티드 are still close behind, while 블랙번 로버스 have three matches in hand on the leaders. 노팅엄 포리스트 have slipped back into the relegation zone behind 셰필드 유나이티드, while 올덤 애슬레틱 are still in the relegation zone and 미들즈브러 now occupy bottom place. In Division One, 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 still lead the way, though 웨스트햄 유나이티드 have cut their lead down to five points. 포츠머스, 스윈던 타운, 밀월 and 레스터 시티 occupy the playoff zone. A dismal run of form for 트랜미어 로버스 has taken them from second to seventh place in just three months, and they are now six points outside the playoff zone. A dismal month for 그림즈비 타운 has seen their promotion challenge virtually ended; in fact, they are actually closer to the relegation zone than to sixth place (albeit only by goal difference). 브리스틀 로버스 are six points away from safety and look certain for relegation, but fellow strugglers Southend and Cambridge end March still optimistic of avoiding the drop. In Division Two, 스토크 시티 are ten points clear of second-placed 포트 베일 and looking all but assured of promotion. Controversial chairman Stan Flashman leaves Division Three leaders 바닛, and as a parting shot sacks and reinstates manager Barry Fry on the same day.

events.title: In France , start the " Affair OM-VA " corruption scandal by 마르세유 and Valenciennes . One week later, on 26 May, 마르세유's squad win the UEFA Champions League defeating AC 밀란 1–0 at the Olympiastadion in Munich.
